:::{#sol-expected-error-epe}

$$
\ba
& \expgenerr{g}{n}
\\
&\quad = \E{\generr_{\trainset}}
&& \text{(definition)}
\\
&\quad = \E{\E{\sqf{\fitted(X_0) - Y_0} \mid \trainset}}
&& \text{(definition)}
\\
&\quad = \E{\E{\sqf{g\paren{X_0; \trainset} - Y_0} \mid \trainset}}
&& \text{(prediction rule)}
\\
&\quad = \E{\sqf{g\paren{X_0; \trainset} - Y_0}}
&& \text{(iterated expectations)}
\\
&\quad = \E{\E{\sqf{g\paren{X_0; \trainset} - Y_0} \mid X_0}}
&& \text{(iterated expectations)}
\\
&\quad = \E{\epe{g}{n}{X_0}}
&& \text{(definition)}
\ea
$$

The steps labeled "definition" apply
@eq-expected-generalization-error, @eq-generalization-error and @eq-epe, in that order,
and the step labeled "prediction rule" applies @eq-prediction-rule,
$\fitted(X_0) = g\paren{X_0; \trainset}$.
The two steps labeled "iterated expectations" use the
[law of iterated expectations](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#thm-lie),
the first conditioning on $\trainset$ and the second on $X_0$.
The last line needs $\trainset$ to be independent of $(X_0, Y_0)$:
then, given $X_0 = x$,
$\trainset$ still has its unconditional distribution,
as @def-epe requires.

:::
